title: Send connector maximum message size is 25 MB or less
description: The MaxMessageSize property on each send connector MUST be set to 25 MB or less. Oversized messages consume excessive bandwidth and storage and may be used to conduct denial-of-service attacks against remote servers.
subject: Organization

references.name: CIS 2.2.4 (L1): Ensure Maximum send size Connector level is set to 25
Message size limits in Exchange Server
DISA STIG EX19-MB-000128: Exchange message size restrictions must be controlled on send connectors (V-259681)

remediation.description: Set MaxMessageSize to 25 MB or less on all send connectors.
remediation.scriptTemplate:
# Set the send size limit on all send connectors.
Get-SendConnector | Set-SendConnector -MaxMessageSize 25MB

considerations: Reducing the maximum send size may cause legitimate large-attachment emails to be rejected. Coordinate with business stakeholders before lowering the limit.
